values.value: Looking past this migration: is there anything you are hoping to get from the wider Salesforce stack later — Marketing Cloud Next capabilities, or Data 360 / Data Cloud as the eventual home for your data model — rather than from Marketing Cloud Engagement itself? Tell us which use cases those ambitions are attached to.

ONE PROBE, FROM TWO. Until this merge, migration-accelerator/instrument/migration-accelerator/supplements/sfmc_classic_readiness.yaml asked mcn_forward_use_cases ("capabilities you are expecting from Marketing Cloud Next rather than the platform you're migrating onto") and, two questions later, data_360_forward_option ("pointed at Data 360 / Data Cloud as the eventual home"). They are the same question — what are you hoping for later — put twice to someone who has just been told this migration targets Marketing Cloud Engagement, and a respondent who answered the first honestly had nothing to add to the second. Merged rather than dropped because both halves earn their place: the capability half and the data-model half of a forward-looking wish are different sentences and the readout's roadmap section uses both. UNSCORED, for the reason both parents were unscored, and it is the same sentence: migration-accelerator/instrument/migration-accelerator/supplements/mcn_readiness.yaml states the precedent verbatim in shared_audience_definitions — "Left UNSCORED on purpose ... every 1-3 banding of it that was tried lost the thing that made it discriminating." Here the reason is stronger than precedent. The migration target is Marketing Cloud Engagement; scoring a wish list for a DIFFERENT platform into this tenant's readiness index would state that MCN is the destination when it is not, and a classic MCE migration requires no Data Cloud at all — see migration-accelerator/instrument/migration-accelerator/pairs/hubspot_to_sfmc.yaml slot 5, whose top of scale is a decomposable object graph (subscriber key, sendable data extensions, Contact Builder attribute sets) precisely because classic MCE asks for no unified profile, and docs/specs/tier-2/sfmc-target-adapter.md, whose target-side ask is "this Journey needs a sendable entry DE keyed on SubscriberKey with these columns" and nothing more. migration-accelerator/instrument/migration-accelerator/supplements/mcn_readiness.yaml scores data_cloud_state because on an MCN target Data Cloud IS the prerequisite stack (skills/mce-mcn-helper/references/skills/10-roadmap.md, Step 2, foundation gates every other lane); importing that scoring here would mark a client with no Data Cloud plans as unready for a platform that never asked for it. What this produces is a verbatim note attributed to the use case, feeding a forward-looking paragraph and nothing else. See docs/specs/tier-2/sfmc-next-target-adapter.md for what MCN would actually require, none of which is in scope on this pair.
